answer: A ballot counts only when vine holds signatures from each chosen lagoon whose zephyr sample fails a correlation test; shared rack, route or funding makes samples correlate, so one principal’s heads fold into one lagoon. Head one needs two such signatures and locks 2 vine. Head k needs k+1 such signatures, all outside every earlier set, and locks k+1 vine; n heads cost n(n+3)/2 vine plus that many unrelated lagoon signatures.
